data: Doctor appointment before starting the treatment plan

Today, Mimi and I met with my hemato-oncologist. She set the date for the first chemotherapy session on June 15th!

Reflection

Usually, the days prior to a doctor appointment are filled with anxiety and fear. But this time, I felt a lot of peace and calmness. Mimi said that she also felt the same way. I understood that this is coming from Jehovah, answering the prayers of the brotherhood and my family. I am very grateful for that.

A righteous man’s supplication has a powerful effect

— James 5:16b
